title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: data management framework telemetry in Application Insights
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, telemetry configuration paths and Azure ingestion controls are supported. One minor checklist inconsistency remains: feature enablement is an instruction without a corresponding controls-table row.

claims.quote: Production environment focus – Configure Application Insights to collect only essential telemetry in production environments. This approach reduces data volume and associated costs.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A workspace cap is enabled in Azure portal at Log Analytics workspaces > workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Daily Cap > ON.
claims.quote:
From the Log Analytics workspaces menu, select your workspace, and then Usage and estimated costs.
2. Select Daily Cap at the top of the page.
3. Select ON and then set the data volume limit in GB/day.

claims.claim: The shown PUT workspace request at api-version=2026-03-01 accepts location and properties.workspaceCapping.dailyQuotaGb to set the ingestion cap.
claims.quote:
PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{workspaceName}?api-version=2026-03-01
location | True | string
properties.workspaceCapping | The daily volume cap for ingestion.
dailyQuotaGb

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: The workspace cap applies to billable Analytics and Basic table ingestion, rather than only DMF telemetry.
claims.quote: stopping collection of billable log data for tables in the Analytics or Basic table plans for the rest of a 24-hour period whenever your specified threshold is reached.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Auxiliary tables are exempt from the workspace daily cap.
claims.quote: Tables in the Auxiliary table plan are not subject to any daily cap.

claims.claim: Reaching the cap stops covered collection for the remainder of the daily period.
claims.quote: stopping collection of billable log data for tables in the Analytics or Basic table plans for the rest of a 24-hour period whenever your specified threshold is reached.

claims.claim: Monitoring and alerts relying on capped ingestion are impaired once collection stops.
claims.quote: once the daily cap is reached, data collection stops. This will impact your ability to monitor resources, receive alerts, and maintain the health and functionality of dependent services and solutions.

claims.claim: Data collected above the daily cap is still billed.
claims.quote: If data is collected above the cap, it's still billed.

claims.claim: For workspace-based Application Insights, the effective daily cap is the smaller of the Application Insights and Log Analytics caps.
claims.quote: For workspace-based Application Insights resources, the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.

claims.claim: Setting a workspace cap requires Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write, provided for example by Log Analytics Contributor.
claims.quote: Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write permissions to the Log Analytics workspaces you set the daily cap on, as provided by the Log Analytics Contributor built-in role, for example.

claims.claim: The daily-cap page lists Application Insights Component Contributor for setting caps on classic Application Insights resources.
claims.quote: microsoft.insights/components/CurrentBillingFeatures/write permissions to the classic Application Insights resources you set the daily cap on, as provided by the Application Insights Component Contributor built-in role, for example.
